One day, Tom felt sad. He wanted to play outside, but it was closed. His mom said, "You can have a cookie, but first you must clean your room." Tom said, "I will clean it up." So, Tom started to clean his room.

, in a small town, there was a little girl named Lucy. Lucy loved to play with her soft, fluffy cat. They played together every day and had lots of fun.

Lucy carefully attached the soft cat to the toy cat. She was very careful with the cat. But then, something unexpected happened. The soft toy cat started to move! It was not a toy cat, but a real cat!
The real cat looked at Lucy and said, "Thank you for being gentle with me. I was a cat because I was a cat, but your love turned me back into a cat." Lucy was very surprised. She promised to always be gentle with her new friend, and they had many more fun days together.
